headline: Long-read and learned models resolve RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interaction sites
label: Rna Interaction Profiling Methods
summary: Long-read sequencing and deep learning now map RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interactions at isoform and sequence-level resolution.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational and sequencing-based methods for resolving RNA interactions. dirCLIP couples CLIP with amplification-free nanopore long-read sequencing to map RBP binding to specific full-length RNA isoforms, adding isoform-level resolution to protein-binding maps. PCLIPtools offers a lightweight statistical framework that estimates high-confidence RBP-RNA sites from PAR-CLIP data using read depth and T-to-C conversions. On the RNA-RNA side, RIME is a deep learning duplex predictor built on a nucleic acid language model, and it identifies low-complexity repeats as hubs of RNA-RNA interactions. CROP and ExoShorkie are less directly connected: CROP is a feature-independent, context-aware model for CRISPR-Cas9 frameshift rates, and ExoShorkie uses transfer learning to improve yeast RNA-seq coverage prediction on held-out exogenous genomes. What is new is the pairing of long-read sequencing and protein-binding chemistry with learned sequence models that predict interaction or coverage outcomes directly.
